purpose: Inventory and assess the complete Matrix Reprogrammed email capture, verification, preference, unsubscribe, segmentation, newsletter and delivery-event lifecycle before any live behaviour changes.
objective: Make email capture and daily/weekly delivery reliable, consent-backed, observable and fail-closed without disrupting the existing Worker, D1 membership, forum persistence, authentication, public downloads or payment-deferred state.
principles: D1 MEMBERS_DB is the intended authoritative subscriber and consent store; KV may remain a compatibility and recovery layer but must not produce false success.
A signup response is successful only when authoritative persistence is confirmed and the next lifecycle state is explicit.
Marketing consent, account verification and newsletter subscription are related but distinct states and must remain auditable.
No campaign may be delivered to pending, suppressed, unsubscribed, bounced, complained, deleted or unverified contacts unless a lawful transactional exception applies.
Brevo contact state and D1 state must be reconcilable; neither provider success nor local success may be silently assumed.
Every campaign send must record segment, canonical content version, recipients, provider message or campaign identifiers and delivery outcomes.
Preferences and unsubscribe must work without requiring a logged-in account, using secure scoped tokens.
Daily and weekly sends remain disabled until the complete fixture lifecycle and failure-path suite passes.
Existing production Worker routes, forum persistence, authentication, memberships and payment-deferred state remain protected.
acceptanceLifecycle: authoritative D1 subscriber and consent records are created
provider contact is synchronized or a visible retry is queued
verification message is sent with a single-use expiring token
verification activates the correct marketing state and segment
subscriber receives only eligible scheduled content
preferences can be read and updated using a secure scoped token
unsubscribe immediately suppresses all marketing segments
provider and D1 unsubscribe states reconcile
future campaign selection excludes the unsubscribed address
resubscribe requires an explicit new consent action
delivery, bounce, complaint and click events remain auditable
exitCondition: The complete signup-to-unsubscribe lifecycle passes deterministic fixtures, provider-failure simulation, idempotency, consent, suppression, segmentation, event-ingest and non-mutation checks before any live campaign or route activation.
